name: goblin_boarders_no_counter_without_your_attack
notes: P042d2e7580 G4, the negative twin. Printed: 'Raid - This creature enters with a +1/+1 counter on it if you attacked this turn.' Seat 0 goes to combat but declares no attacker (the Bear stays home), then casts Goblin Boarders in its postcombat main phase: it enters as the printed 3/2 with no counter. Next, on seat 1's turn, seat 1 attacks seat 0 with its Wolf (seat 0 takes 3), and then a second Goblin Boarders enters under seat 0's control: the opponent attacked this turn, not you, so it also has no counter.
